summary: Iteration 28: Strategy Marketplace Feature tested. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend components verified - marketplace modal opens correctly with search/sort controls and displays strategy cards with all required fields (name, ticker, win rate, P&L, Sharpe ratio, views, clones). Note: Preview environment has slow API response times (~39s) causing initial loading delay.

integration_issues.issue: API response takes ~39 seconds in preview environment, causing prolonged 'Loading marketplace...' state. This appears to be an environment issue, not a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: strategy.py marketplace endpoints correctly implement publish, list, get, clone with proper Pro-only restrictions
StrategyMarketplace.jsx has all required data-testid attributes: strategy-marketplace, marketplace-search, marketplace-sort, marketplace-list, marketplace-card-{id}, clone-btn-{id}, marketplace-close
StrategyBuilder.jsx has publish-marketplace-btn and publish-section data-testid attributes
Navbar.jsx has nav-marketplace-btn in Strategies dropdown and nav-marketplace-menu-btn in user profile dropdown
Clone endpoint correctly increments clone count and saves to user's strategies
View count correctly increments on GET /api/marketplace/{strategy_id}
Sort options (newest, win_rate, pnl, clones) all work correctly
seed_data_creation: TEST_Momentum RSI Strategy published during testing (2 instances)
